commentary_segments.text: Binary currents can also be switched directly as shown in this slide. The binary code determines which currents are added towards the input of the opamp. Now, of course, the mismatch between the binary current sources will play a role. In principle, current sources do not match as well as capacitors. Limited resolution is therefore obtained. Moreover glitches can occur during transitions to higher bits. As this is also a result of mismatch, careful layout will have to be ensured. Glitches can be avoided however, by using a thermometer code rather than a binary code.
